notes.subject: יקפצון
notes.rationale: 'They are shut up / gathered in / cut off' — KJV 'taken out of the way', JPS 'gathered in'; the closing-up verb is kept.

notes.subject: sabu
notes.rationale: שבלת is an ear of grain; Bambara 'sabu' carries the standing-grain picture.

notes.subject: יקפצון
notes.rationale: Rare passive form of קפץ, 'they are contracted/closed up', a distinctive ending -ון.

notes.subject: מעט
notes.rationale: The verse measures the wicked's height — 'a little while' and they are no more.

translation: U bɛ kun jɛ dɔɔnin, u ka bɔ yen; u bɛ dɔgɔya, i n'a fɔ bɛɛ lajɛlen ye, u bɛ lajɛ; i n'a fɔ sabu kun de ye, u bɛ u kankolo.
